name: Yukino Sugushiro
source: Easygoing and generally calming, Yukino is known for being the mediator of the group, but she is also a conspiracy theorist extraordinaire. She's bad at singing, and is fond of teasing Nerisu a lot, only stopping when lori tells her to. She also enjoys history, knowing a lot about Caladrian history in particular for the spicy drama hat unfolds.
